description:
The existing apply_category_op cascade (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs:set_channel_category at line ~1128) mutates Chat.categoryId in place via objects_mut("Chat", ...) but does NOT call bump_state("Chat", ...) or push a ChangeEntry to change_log_mut("Chat", ...). As a result:

- Space/set updateCategories that wholesale-replaces channelIds silently mutates Chat.categoryId for affected channels, but Chat/changes subscribers see no delta.
- Space/set addCategories with non-empty channelIds list moves channels into the category (via set_channel_category) but Chat/changes shows no delta.
- Space/set removeCategories cascades all channels back to uncategorized, but Chat/changes shows no delta.

Three call sites in apply_category_op invoke set_channel_category and produce this gap:
- memory.rs ~799 (AddCategory: set_channel_category(inner, account_id, ch_id, Some(&new_id)))
- memory.rs ~875 (RemoveCategory: set_channel_category(inner, account_id, ch_id, None))
- memory.rs ~972 and ~975 (UpdateCategory: set_channel_category for removed/added)

Discovered while implementing JMAP-g7wu.2.4.4 (Channel variants), which DOES bump Chat state and log Chat changes correctly. The new Channel implementation tracks chats_created/chats_updated/chats_destroyed sets and emits a consolidated Chat ChangeEntry at end-of-call (same batching rationale as the Space entry). The Category cascade can adopt the same pattern by:

1. Adding a chats_updated: HashSet<Id> tracking var to apply_space_patch (already present after JMAP-g7wu.2.4.4 landed).
2. In set_channel_category (or its callers), push the affected chat_id into chats_updated.
3. The existing post-loop bookkeeping at apply_space_patch end-of-call (already in place after JMAP-g7wu.2.4.4) will then emit a Chat ChangeEntry covering Category-cascade Chat mutations too.

This is a small follow-up — the infrastructure now exists; only the Category-cascade call sites need to populate chats_updated. Tests should assert Chat/changes returns the affected channel ids after a Category cascade.
title: MemoryBackend Category cascade does not bump Chat state or log Chat changes
